how_to_apply: Visit the official web portal: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
Go to the "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" tab and open the "Application Forms" sub-tab.
Download the blank application form and the other required certificates/forms.
Fill the application form as per the format hosted on the web portal; applications not in this format will be rejected.

Send the duly filled application by normal post or drop box to any one of the addresses listed in the brochure (the brochure lists over 130 IAF stations and drop-box locations across India, grouped by Command headquarters, each marked with the eligible stream - Hospitality and/or Housekeeping). Candidates should choose the location where they wish to apply.
Ensure the application reaches the chosen address on or before the due date given in the Employment News notification (17 August 2026, as stated in the brochure).

Note: Applications received after the due date will not be accepted. Candidates submitting multiple applications will have their candidature rejected entirely. Incomplete applications, in terms of information or documents, will be rejected.
important_instructions: Selection in the Indian Air Force is fair, transparent, and merit-based only; no bribe is required at any stage. Candidates not reporting for the written test at or before the cut-off time will not be permitted to appear. Candidates should be prepared to stay for the entire duration of the tests at their own expense; no TA/DA is admissible. Mobile phones, smart watches, and electronic gadgets are not permitted in the examination hall. Original educational mark sheets/passing certificates are compulsory for the selection test; candidates with DigiLocker-verified certificates may appear provisionally and must produce originals within a specified time. Candidates should get dental tartar and stains removed and clear ear wax before the medical examination, and should be prepared to stay for four to five days (own arrangement) for the medical test. If there is any variation between the English and Hindi versions of the notification, the English version is authentic. The Indian Air Force reserves the right to cancel the entire selection process at any stage, without assigning any reason. Data entered in the application form is treated as final; no changes are permitted later, and wrong data entry will disqualify the candidature.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. If a candidate clears all stages of the selection procedure, the upper age limit as on the date of enrolment should be 22 years. Only unmarried male candidates are eligible for enrolment as Agniveervayu Non-Combatant. Candidates must give an undertaking not to marry during the four-year engagement period. Any Agniveervayu Non-Combatant who marries during this period will be dismissed from service. Only unmarried Agniveervayu Non-Combatant will be eligible for later selection in the regular cadre as NC(E). Candidates must sign a voluntary undertaking accepting this condition at the time of enrolment. Candidates must have passed Matriculation/equivalent examination from an Education Board recognised by the Central Government, a State Government, or a Union Territory, as on the date of registration. The brochure clarifies that the above medical standards are broad guidelines only; final medical fitness will be conclusively decided by the Medical Board. Consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (banned under the NDPS Act 1985) is a rejection criterion for selection, and a ground for disciplinary action including dismissal if found after enrolment. The IAF follows a zero-tolerance policy on alcoholism and substance abuse. Permanent body tattoos are not permitted, except on the inner forearm (elbow to wrist), the back/reverse side of the hand, or tribal tattoos as per custom and tradition. Offensive, obscene, indecent, sexist, or racist tattoos are prohibited anywhere on the body. The Selection Centre has the final say on whether a tattoo is acceptable. Only Sikh candidates whose religion prohibits cutting hair or shaving are permitted to grow hair and/or retain a beard and moustache.

rows.standard: Proportionate to height and age, as applicable for IAF
6/36 in each eye, correctable to 6/9 in each eye; colour vision CP-III; refractive error not exceeding +3.5D including astigmatism; corneal surgery (PRK/LASIK) not acceptable
Normal hearing - able to hear forced whisper from 6 metres with each ear separately
Healthy gums, good set of teeth, minimum 14 dental points; dental implants/implant-supported prosthesis not awarded dental points; fixed or removable orthodontic appliances lead to unfit status

Must be fit for the Air Force, of normal anatomy without loss of any appendage, free from active/latent or acute/chronic medical or surgical disability, communicable disease, infection, or skin ailments

Candidates found with predominant characteristics of the opposite gender on external physical examination will be rejected; candidates who have undergone gender reassignment surgery will be declared unfit

content_sections.heading: Job Profile for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be required to perform duties under either the Hospitality or Housekeeping stream, in addition to any specific duties assigned in organisational interest. Hospitality Stream: Cooking, kitchen management, presentation of dishes, maintaining a clean and orderly kitchen, safe storage of food and other items, handling crockery/cutlery/refrigeration, laying tables/chairs, and serving food and water. Housekeeping Stream: Cleaning of floors, roads, rooms, bathrooms, commodes, and urinals; making brooms; cutting grass/hedges; ground levelling and digging trenches; watering gardens; washing utensils and clothes; filling and carrying water; handling office equipment; and additionally, hair cutting, shaving, head massage, ironing clothes, stitching or repair of leather items, shoe polishing, and cutting/stitching/altering garments.

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Salary and Benefits
content_sections.text: Agniveervayu Non-Combatant recruited under this scheme will be paid an Agniveer package of ₹30,000 per month with a fixed yearly increment, along with risk and hardship allowances (as applicable in IAF), dress and travel allowances, and perks such as ration, clothing, accommodation, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per existing rules. After four years, the total contribution to the Agniveer Corpus Fund is approximately ₹5.02 lakh from the individual and a matching ₹5.02 lakh from the Government of India, giving an approximate exit amount of ₹10.04 lakh as the Seva Nidhi package (absolute amount, excluding interest). Agniveervayu Non-Combatant are not required to contribute to any Provident Fund, and there is no entitlement to gratuity or any pensionary benefit. Leave: 30 days of annual leave per year; sick leave based on medical advice by a competent medical authority. Medical and CSD Facilities: Entitled to medical facility at service hospitals and CSD provisions during the engagement period. Insurance: Non-contributory life insurance cover of ₹48 lakh for the duration of the engagement period. Agniveer Skill Certificate: A detailed skill-set certificate is provided at the end of the engagement period, highlighting skills and competency acquired. On completion of four years of service, Agniveervayu Non-Combatant may apply for permanent enrolment in the IAF as NC(E); up to 25% of each specific batch may be enrolled in the regular cadre based on objective criteria including performance, though no candidate has a right to further enrolment. Personnel enrolled under this scheme are not eligible for Ex-Servicemen status after discharge, and release at own request before completing the engagement period is not permissible except in exceptional cases with approval of the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Visit the official web portal: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in . Go to the "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" tab and open the "Application Forms" sub-tab. Download the blank application form and the other required certificates/forms. Fill the application form as per the format hosted on the web portal; applications not in this format will be rejected. Attach the required documents (see below). Send the duly filled application by normal post or drop box to any one of the addresses listed in the brochure (the brochure lists over 130 IAF stations and drop-box locations across India, grouped by Command headquarters, each marked with the eligible stream - Hospitality and/or Housekeeping). Candidates should choose the location where they wish to apply. Ensure the application reaches the chosen address on or before the due date given in the Employment News notification (17 August 2026, as stated in the brochure). Note: Applications received after the due date will not be accepted. Candidates submitting multiple applications will have their candidature rejected entirely. Incomplete applications, in terms of information or documents, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Class 10th/Matriculation mark sheet and Class 10th passing certificate A recent passport-size colour photograph (not older than six months as on the last date of receipt of application), front portrait in a light background without headgear (except for Sikhs), taken while holding a black slate bearing the candidate's name and the date the photo was taken, written clearly in white chalk in capital letters. Two copies of the same photo must be retained for submission at the time of enrolment. Consent certificate signed by parents/legal guardian, for candidates below 18 years of age; candidates above 18 years must sign a self-consent certificate A self-addressed envelope with a ten-rupee stamp affixed

content_sections.heading: IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates whose applications are accepted will be issued admit cards for the written test, which will state the date, location, and time of the test. The selection process has four phases: The written test is common for both streams and will be conducted at the station/location where the candidate submitted the application. Candidates reporting for the written test must carry their Aadhaar card (candidates from Jammu & Kashmir, Assam, and Meghalaya may carry another valid ID if they do not have an Aadhaar card), a character certificate signed by a Gazetted Officer/Panchayat Officer/School Principal/College Principal (not older than 6 months, with office seal), the original 10th/Matriculation passing certificate (or a DigiLocker-verified printout), the original 10th marksheet, and an experience certificate if any. Candidates found using unfair means, carrying prohibited electronic devices, or engaging in impersonation will be debarred permanently from Agniveervayu Non-Combatant selection tests. Only candidates who pass the written test are permitted to appear for PFT, which is common and qualifying for both streams. Height Check: Minimum acceptable height 152 cm; candidates below this are disqualified from further tests. PFT-I: A 1.6 km run to be completed within 7 minutes (additional time is given at high altitude: nil up to 5,000 feet, +30 seconds from 5,001–9,000 feet, +120 seconds from 9,001–12,000 feet). PFT-II: 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups, and 20 squats, each to be completed within 1 minute, with rest breaks of 10 minutes (after the run), 2 minutes (after push-ups), and 2 minutes (after sit-ups) between tests. The SST is qualifying in nature. Candidates must be willing to undergo training and perform any task associated with their opted stream; unwillingness to perform a task leads to disqualification in SST. For the Hospitality stream, candidates are assessed on cooking-related skills, kitchen sanitation and hygiene, serving food/water/beverages, personal hygiene, and knowledge of kitchen fire/safety precautions. For the Housekeeping stream, candidates are assessed on sweeping floors/cleaning bathrooms, cutting grass/watering gardens/digging trenches, washing utensils, and demonstrated ability in at least one of washing and ironing clothes, hair cutting/dressing/shampooing, stitching of leather items, or tailoring/pattern-cutting skills. A certain number of candidates who qualify in SST, as per merit, undergo a medical examination by the Air Force Medical team as per IAF medical standards. This includes baseline investigations such as Blood Haemogram (Hb, TLC, DLC, Platelets), Urine RE/ME, Biochemistry (blood sugar fasting and post-prandial, serum cholesterol, RFT, LFT), chest radiograph (PA view), ECG, and any other investigation the Recruiting Medical Officer considers necessary. faq.question: Q1. What is IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Indian Air Force to enrol Agniveervayu Non-Combatant personnel under the Agnipath Scheme, for Intake 01/2027, in the Hospitality or Housekeeping stream.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The brochure does not specify a numeric vacancy count. It lists application locations by stream (Hospitality and/or Housekeeping), and some locations note that the vacancy in stream will be updated shortly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Candidates must be born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009. If a candidate clears all selection stages, the upper age limit as on the date of enrolment should be 22 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation/equivalent examination from an Education Board recognised by the Central Government, State Government, or a Union Territory.

faq.question: Q6. Can married candidates apply for Agniveervayu Non-Combatant?
faq.answer: No. Only unmarried male candidates are eligible, and they must undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates get an Agniveer package of ₹30,000 per month with a fixed yearly increment, plus risk and hardship allowances, dress and travel allowances, and other perks as per existing rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The selection process has four phases: a Written Test (General English and General Knowledge, 30 marks total), a Physical Fitness Test (height check, a 1.6 km run, push-ups/sit-ups/squats), a Stream Suitability Test, and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in and submit the duly filled form along with the required documents by normal post or drop box to one of the addresses listed in the brochure, before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the engagement period for Agniveervayu Non-Combatant?
faq.answer: Agniveervayu Non-Combatant are enrolled under the Air Force Act 1950 for a period of four years, and the IAF is not obliged to retain them beyond this period.
